"Create a realistic and highly responsive Penalty Goalkeeper Training Game focused on improving human reaction time and reflexes.
Core Gameplay:
Player controls a goalkeeper defending a standard football goal.
Ball is always shot from the official 11-meter penalty spot.
Each shot has a completely random direction (left, right, high, low, center, near post, far post) and random height.
The difficulty and accuracy of the shot depend on the shooter’s skill level (Amateur, Semi-pro, Professional, World-class). Higher skill = more accurate placement + faster and more unpredictable shots.
Multiple shot power modes: Weak, Medium, Strong, and Maximum. Power directly affects ball speed realistically (equivalent to real-life professional penalty kick speeds, approximately 80–120+ km/h).
Goalkeeper Mechanics:
Full control of movement left/right along the goal line.
Ability to dive (left/right), jump high, and stretch.
Reaction speed and diving speed can be upgraded.
Physics should feel realistic: ball trajectory, gravity, air resistance, and bounce.
Goalkeeper has a limited reaction window based on ball speed (to train real human reflexes).
Game Modes:
Reaction Training Mode – Endless random penalties with increasing speed and difficulty. Focus purely on reaction time.
Career / Skill Progression – Face different shooters with rising skill levels.
Challenge Mode – Fixed number of shots, try to save as many as possible.
Custom Mode – Player can freely set ball speed, shooter accuracy, and power.
Key Goals of the Game:
Maximize improvement of human reaction speed and decision-making under pressure.
Provide instant visual and audio feedback after every save or miss.
Track reaction time (in milliseconds) for every shot.
Show detailed statistics: save percentage, average reaction time, best reaction time, improvement over time.
Visual @COMMENT_BODY@ Feel:
Clean, high-contrast graphics so the ball is easy to track.
Smooth 60 FPS+ gameplay.
Optional first-person or close third-person camera from the goalkeeper’s perspective for maximum immersion.
Realistic ball physics and sound effects (kick impact, diving, net sound).
Make the game addictive, fair, and scientifically useful for training reflexes. Prioritize tight controls and low input lag above everything else.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable goalkeeper penalty-training web game focused on reaction time, reflexes, and goalkeeping practice.

## Requirements
- Realistic 11-meter penalty gameplay with random placement and randomized shot speed/power.
- Multiple shooter skill levels, power modes, and game modes.
- Keyboard and touch controls for movement, diving, and jumping.
- Responsive 60 FPS-style canvas gameplay with save, miss, speed, reaction, and statistics feedback.
- Track save percentage, average/best reaction time, streaks, trends, and progression.
- No clarifying questions; reasonable assumptions allowed.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a single-page vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript canvas game.
- Used a close third-person goalkeeper viewpoint with a dark, high-contrast stadium aesthetic.
- Added persistent career-best reaction time using `localStorage`.
- Used randomized placement families for posts, corners, center, and height variation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the full responsive game interface in `index.html`.
- Implemented canvas stadium, goal, net, goalkeeper, and ball rendering.
- Implemented Reaction, Career, Challenge, and Custom modes.
- Added Amateur through World-class shooter difficulty and Weak through Maximum power settings.
- Added goalkeeper movement, jump, keyboard dives, touch/swipe dives, and on-screen dive buttons.
- Added timed ball flight, shot release, speed labels, save/goal resolution, audio cues, and visual result feedback.
- Added session save rate, reaction average/best, shot count, reaction trend chart, and persistent career best.
- Added goalkeeper reaction and dive-reach upgrades.
- Verified JavaScript syntax.
- Started and tested the game in Chromium; gameplay advanced through shots and produced stats.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
